svg.aria-label: Editorial variant: Resonate masthead over five numbered sections - build, deploy, store, reach, extend - each with a scale line and a row of logos.
svg.text: From one laptop to millions of serverless invocations.
From one SQLite file to S3 at any scale.
From one HTTP call to a global Pub/Sub fan-out.
From one plugin you wrote to 400+ on the roadmap.
